lines.en: - Are you kidding me? - Don't you talk to my granddaughter like that.
I'm pretty sure you're overdoing it.
Okay, if Carly's so tough, let's go right now.
Get off me! Get off me!
Unbelievable, Carly Shea just tackled the sickly grandmother of Shelby Marks.
Listen, I was gonna take it easy on you, but now you're going down.
